source_snapshot.items: Test BMC I2C-6 connectivity to Mezzanine Network Board2 IO expander and FRU
source_snapshot.procedure: On bus5 runs literal `i2c detect -y -q 5`, reads mux0x76, writes0x02 for port1, then repeats detection; PID1114953.
source_snapshot.criteria: No Board2 address/register/content oracle; generic artifact language only.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; replaces remote functional procedure with probing/soldering.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Flags command ambiguity/write risk but retains unsupported physical-only coverage.

old_problem: Literal `i2c detect` is unresolved and broad quick-write discovery lacks device safety; Board2 IO-expander/FRU addresses/content, mux0x76 semantics/ownership, measurable criteria and exact restore are absent.
disposition_reason: ED-03 permits a functional BMC test but not guessed OEM endpoints or unsafe scans. Board2 identity must come from PID-defined non-mutating reads, not address delta or invented physical probing. Pending/Requires Confirmation remains until safe transactions and restoration are approved.
decision_basis: Read row128/history2518 and kept Board2/mux0x76 distinct from completed Board1/mux0x72 row127.
Preserved literal command text, bus5,0x76,0x02/port1, IO expander, FRU and PID1114953.
Rejected blind quick-write scanning and unsupported probe/solder/photo substitution.
Required exact safe IO-expander register and immutable FRU signature/checksum reads plus original-byte restore.
No command resolution, scan, mux write, endpoint write, BMC reset or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Mezzanine Network Board2 IO-expander/FRU functional path
test_case.purpose: Verify selecting BMC bus5 mux0x76 port1 exposes the PID-defined Board2 IO expander and FRU through safe device-specific reads, without disturbing other channels, then restore exact routing.
required_package: IO-expander address and safe identity/status register/value mask
FRU address, safe offset/length and immutable signature/checksum oracle
Mux semantics/ownership/exclusivity, error limits, original-state restore and BMC recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not run the unresolved broad quick-write scan. After approval, baseline owner/health and original0x76 byte, select port1 with approved0x02 or masked equivalent, perform only PID-defined read-only IO-expander identity and FRU signature/header reads, compare exact values, restore the original byte and verify other channels/services.
test_case.expected_result: The Board2 IO expander and FRU return their signed address-specific identity/content within bounds only through the intended port, no unrelated bus/channel/service regression occurs, and mux plus endpoint/management state return exactly to baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires device-specific content, not mere address appearance. Unresolved tool/quick-write, unexpected address delta, wrong signature/checksum, NACK/timeout/arbitration loss, unrelated impact or incomplete restore fails; physical probing is not required absent separate scope.
safety_gate: Authoritative Board2 endpoint map and independent BMC recovery.
No blind/quick-write scan or arbitrary address access.
No raw mux access while bus/mux is owned; capture original byte and preserve bits.
One bounded select/read sequence; abort/restore on any endpoint or management anomaly.
expected_evidence: Pre/post address-specific IO-expander and FRU values/checksum with timestamps/status
Exact mux restoration/readback, endpoint health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Restore the exact recorded0x76 byte, verify Board2 endpoints, unrelated channels and BMC services. Use independent BMC recovery only for stuck bus; never probe alternate addresses or auto-retry.

source_conflict.reason: Command spelling/safety and measurable Board2 criteria are unresolved; prior reviews add unsupported physical-only work.
